title: NULL and Missing Facts
summary: NULL means a fact is missing or not applicable, not an empty string and not zero. The lesson shows why ordinary equality does not find NULL.
learning_objectives: Read ecommerce.customers as a one-table row set.
Write or explain SQL using only Phase 1 concepts for null and missing facts.
reflection_prompts: Which row did your query include or exclude, and why?

references.why: PostgreSQL reference syntax for the small SQL forms used in this lesson.
